_help: Edit this file when news changes who starts. qb_starters: the QB a team will start (short name as in play-by-play, e.g. C.Wentz) and the last week it applies to; after that week the site goes back to whoever actually started the team's most recent game. players_out: non-QB regulars ruled out in the news but not yet on an official injury report (side = off or def). Save on GitHub and the site rebuilds in a few minutes. traded: players moved to a new team since their last game (projections use the new team; QBs are set in qb_starters).
